title: From Tololing to Tiger Hill: Five battles that defeated Pakistan in Kargil

Khalubar's capture shattered Pakistan's eastern flank, completing India's strategic gains.

title: This tiny Himalayan village lures tourists for what happens after the sun drops

It became India's first International Dark Sky Reserve in December 2022.  Local communities actively preserve these skies, integrating astronomy with cultural traditions.  Astrotourism here focuses on community involvement and preservation rather than extraction.
